::: {.lede}
I am a PhD student in the Department of Economics at Georgetown University. My research is in economic theory, with a focus on matching under incomplete information, information design, and political economy.
:::

## Research interests

**Primary.** Matching theory, mechanism design, information design.

**Secondary.** Social choice, political economy, decision theory.

Most of my current work asks what happens to the structural results of classical matching theory — the Lone Wolf theorem, lattice structure of stable outcomes — once agents hold private information and transfers are available. A second line studies committees that communicate by voting rather than deliberating separately.
